blessed_by_ashes.description: Grants protection against buildings catching fire!
blessed_by_ashes.flavor: Where there's smoke, there's... actually no fire!
blessed_by_ashes.name: Blessed by Ashes

bloodline_bond.description: Only clan members can tap into the divine power of this religion magic
bloodline_bond.flavor: Everyone else just gets to admire them from the dark
bloodline_bond.name: Bloodline Bond

cast_blood_rain.description: Beseech the skies to bleed and heal the wounded below
cast_blood_rain.flavor: If it works, then questions are best left unasked
cast_blood_rain.name: Cast Blood Rain

cast_cure.description: Channel divine energy to heal illnesses and diseases
cast_cure.flavor: Know that nothing heals without leaving scars
cast_cure.name: Cast Cure

cast_curse.description: Ability to inflict a dark curse upon enemies
cast_curse.flavor: Revenge is sweet, but curses leave a bitter aftertaste
cast_curse.name: Cast Curse

cast_fire.flavor: Embrace the warmth as the world turns to ash
cast_fire.name: Cast Fire

cast_grass_seeds.description: Ability to make barren land come alive with a blanket of fresh grass
cast_grass_seeds.flavor: Nature's beauty often conceals its cruelty
cast_grass_seeds.name: Create Grass

cast_shield.description: Create a protective bubble to guard against incoming attacks
cast_shield.flavor: A fleeting moment of safety amidst the chaos
cast_shield.name: Bubble Shield

cast_silence.description: Silence your enemies, leaving them unable to cast spells for a time
cast_silence.flavor: Power dies in the absence of words
cast_silence.name: Silence

cosmic_radiation.description: Magic draws from cosmic rays, spreading wasteland with every use
cosmic_radiation.flavor: Cosmic radiation is a silent killer. Like salt, but worse
cosmic_radiation.name: Cosmic Radiation

divine_insight.description: Enlightened by the hands of the divine
divine_insight.flavor: Whoa, this is some serious stuff!
divine_insight.name: Divine Insight

echo_of_the_void.description: Magic summons a singularity into the world
echo_of_the_void.flavor: The Void watches, always seeking opportunities to consume
echo_of_the_void.name: Echo of the Void

hand_of_order.description: Empowers followers to maintain structure, control, and organization in all aspects of life
hand_of_order.name: Hand of Order

infernal_rot.description: The use of magic spreads the infernal biome
infernal_rot.flavor: It spreads like a bad meme, leaving only flames and suffering in its wake
infernal_rot.name: Infernal Influence

minds_awakening.description: The teachings of the faith unlock greater wisdom
minds_awakening.name: Minds Awakening

path_of_unity.description: Unity is the key to surviving the storm ahead
path_of_unity.flavor: Together we rise, alone we are prey
path_of_unity.name: Path of Unity

rite_of_change.description: Allows the transformation of clan members into new subspecies through a sacred ritual
rite_of_change.name: Rite of Change

rite_of_dissent.flavor: The flames of rebellion spread quickly once ignited
rite_of_dissent.name: Rite of Dissent

rite_of_entanglement.description: Summons magical vines that entangle and slow down enemy warriors
rite_of_entanglement.flavor: The earth hungers for fresh embrace
rite_of_entanglement.name: Rite of Entanglement

rite_of_eternal_brew.description: The souls of dead beans enhance the speed and clarity of friendly units
rite_of_eternal_brew.flavor: Mmmm, the agony of freshly roasted beans fills the air
rite_of_eternal_brew.name: Rite of Eternal Brew

rite_of_falling_stars.description: Summons meteorites to bring destruction from above
rite_of_falling_stars.flavor: No one wins when the sky falls
rite_of_falling_stars.name: Rite of Falling Stars

rite_of_fractured_minds.description: Drown enemy minds in madness and despair
rite_of_fractured_minds.flavor: Sanity shatters like glass in their grip
rite_of_fractured_minds.name: Rite of Fractured Minds

rite_of_infernal_wrath.description: Summons fire clouds to rain hellfire upon your enemies
rite_of_infernal_wrath.flavor: Hell itself rains down their judgment
rite_of_infernal_wrath.name: Rite of Infernal Wrath

rite_of_infinite_edges.description: Summon sharp divine angles to judge your enemies
rite_of_infinite_edges.flavor: A little geometry is all it takes to ruin a day
rite_of_infinite_edges.name: Rite of Infinite Edges

rite_of_living_harvest.description: Make trees and plants fight your enemies
rite_of_living_harvest.flavor: The harvest is ripe... for revenge!
rite_of_living_harvest.name: Rite of Living Harvest

rite_of_restless_dead.description: Raise skeletons to fight for your cause!
rite_of_restless_dead.flavor: What is dead will fight again. And again. And again
rite_of_restless_dead.name: Rite of Restless Dead

rite_of_roaring_skies.description: Summons a thunderstorm to strike down your enemies
rite_of_roaring_skies.flavor: It's going to be a noisy ride!
rite_of_roaring_skies.name: Rite of Roaring Skies

rite_of_shattered_earth.description: Calls forth an earthquake to shatter enemy cities
rite_of_shattered_earth.flavor: A tremor here, a crack there, enough to crumble cities
rite_of_shattered_earth.name: Rite of Shattered Earth

rite_of_tempest_call.description: Summons the fury of a stormfront upon your enemies
rite_of_tempest_call.flavor: They'll feel the storm in their very bones!
rite_of_tempest_call.name: Rite of the Tempest Call

rite_of_the_abyss.description: Unleash demons from the abyss to ravage your foe
rite_of_the_abyss.flavor: Unleash the demons, they said. It'll be fun, they said
rite_of_the_abyss.name: Rite of the Abyss

rite_of_unbroken_shield.description: Creates a barrier of protection for your warriors
rite_of_unbroken_shield.flavor: Clean, protected, and bouncing into battle!
rite_of_unbroken_shield.name: Rite of Unbroken Shield

sands_of_ruin.description: Magic transforms the world into an endless desert
sands_of_ruin.flavor: Tampering with the unknown leaves only ruin behind
sands_of_ruin.name: Sands of Ruin

shadowroot.description: Magic weaves corruption through the land
shadowroot.flavor: The ground remembers where shadows walked
shadowroot.name: Shadowroot

spawn_skeleton.description: Raise the dead to fight at your command
spawn_skeleton.flavor: The dead have stories, no mouth to tell
spawn_skeleton.name: Summon Skeleton

spawn_vegetation.description: Ability to spawn plants and trees at will!
spawn_vegetation.flavor: Life finds a way... whether you like it or not
spawn_vegetation.name: Cast Vegetation

summon_lightning.description: Summon lightning from the heavens to strike your foes
summon_lightning.flavor: Sometimes a lightning bolt says more than words ever could
summon_lightning.name: Summon Lightning

summon_tornado.description: Bring the wrath of nature down upon your enemies
summon_tornado.flavor: The spirits linger in the winds, and they are not forgiving
summon_tornado.name: Summon Tornado

teleport.description: Ability to teleport to faraway places
teleport.flavor: Space bends its knee to their will
teleport.name: Teleport

zeal_of_conquest.description: Ignites a burning desire for conquest and endless war
zeal_of_conquest.flavor: Every battle is not just a fight, but a sacred mission
zeal_of_conquest.name: Zeal of Conquest
